decision: Freeze this as the current-feature data build baseline, not a claim of launch readiness or permanently final agricultural knowledge

findings.finding: Whole-schema SELECT exposed partition children outside parent RLS
findings.resolution: Revoke whole-schema grants; grant base tables/views only, keep direct partition reads denied; tested under non-owner role

findings.finding: Raw ingest/quality metadata can include untrusted or sensitive contents
findings.resolution: Keep ingest_runs/raw_objects/quality_issues admin-only and redact secrets in logs

findings.finding: Three sample properties were insufficient for soil-report and nutrient workflows
findings.resolution: Add 12 SHC parameter fixtures, 21 property definitions, explicit original nutrient basis and separate total N/available N

findings.finding: Generic sensor percentage cannot establish volumetric root-zone water
findings.resolution: Add per-sensor basis/calibration, depth-specific field-capacity/wilting-point records; demo moisture remains relative and uncalibrated
findings.status: fixed in schema/demo; runtime calculator gate

findings.finding: Expenses alone cannot support income or sell/hold planning
findings.resolution: Add harvest batches, quality/storage evidence and decimal sale proceeds/costs; enforce matching units, stock and dates

findings.finding: External aliases can silently mix crops, varieties, regions and units
findings.resolution: Add reviewed time-valid typed source mappings and current-key uniqueness; preserve one stable canonical market identity across daily releases

findings.finding: HTTP success is not proof a source is fresh, complete or reliable
findings.resolution: Track per-provider/scope last-good data, source-valid-through, outages and rate limits; keep stale badges and service degraded modes

findings.finding: Messages and tool calls alone do not reliably resume visible progress after disconnect
findings.resolution: Add owned sequenced run events and cursor-based reconnect contract; persist public progress only

findings.finding: Input forms and answers need durable ownership and resume identity
findings.resolution: Persist question schema, waiting status, answer revisions and execution keys; service validates JSON against the request schema

findings.finding: Unversioned tool definitions make capabilities and approval policy difficult to audit
findings.resolution: Snapshot current 11 skills/19 tools with exact argument schemas, workflow hashes and side-effect policy; registry stays inactive until bound to runtime outputs

findings.finding: One current fact does not alone provide compaction checkpoints or correction history
findings.resolution: Add compaction coverage, pending work and token accounting; test correction chain preserves one current fact; semantic retrieval remains evaluated runtime work

findings.finding: Uploaded photos/reports/audio need an owned ingestion state distinct from generated artifacts
findings.resolution: Add owned attachments with hash, scan/quarantine status and extraction metadata; placeholder fixtures explicitly have no actual file

findings.finding: Station trends and model images do not prove a diagnosis
findings.resolution: Add field observations; ask actual image/crop/stage/location; evaluate real field images, permit abstention and expert referral

findings.finding: Warnings need expiry, acknowledgment, scope and source identity
findings.resolution: Add owned alert lifecycle; retain source update/cancel keys and validity; separate mock alerts from official feed

findings.finding: Telemetry does not mean the assistant can execute a pump command
findings.resolution: Add bounded command intent/events, station lane matching, expiry and exact target/action/payload approval hash; no dispatch connector or credentials enabled

findings.finding: Concurrent calendar edits can overwrite each other
findings.resolution: Add increasing row_version; API must compare expected version and return conflict, preserve soft-delete/undo and idempotency; recurrence expands to owned occurrence keys

findings.finding: A default delivery_allowed=false flag alone could later be changed
findings.resolution: Reject demo external email/SMS/WhatsApp delivery at DB level and live command mode on mock station; delivery and actuator services remain disabled

findings.finding: A manually validated label could allow a synthetic price path to be called a forecast
findings.resolution: Reject synthetic-origin real forecasts even when model is marked validated; keep past versus next-year scenarios physically separate Daily weather forecasts also obey each weather series configured maximum lead; next-year daily weather remains scenario-only.

findings.finding: State-only anchors do not exercise local hierarchy joins
findings.resolution: Add explicit fictional district/block/village hierarchy under each state/UT and connect farms to demo villages; no fake LGD or cadastral claim

findings.finding: Synthetic happy paths cannot exercise source outages, unanswered questions or bad hardware intents
findings.resolution: Add outage/waiting/answered/stock/soil fixtures and regression failures. Reserve file/model/provider integration tests for actual adapters

findings.finding: DDL load and fixture counts do not prove a backup can restore usable permissions
findings.resolution: Run pg_dump/pg_restore rehearsal into isolated demo DB; compare every base table and owner isolation; production PITR/object backups still required

findings.finding: No sources are ingested and the current app still points to old storage
findings.resolution: Create separate live/demo services, implement repositories/adapters, authenticate identities, verify endpoints/labels, perform reconciled reversible cutover
findings.status: launch gate; deliberately not cut over

findings.finding: Official tables are still empty and public source catalogs are not a usable agronomic corpus
findings.resolution: Import licensed/versioned regional crop documents, scheme rules, MSP and reviewed treatment references; citations must resolve, stale advice must expire

findings.finding: Demo sowing dates, crop mixes and 120-day cycles are illustrative, especially for perennials
findings.resolution: Never train agronomic/yield models or give real growing instructions from demo; real cycles need local season rules, variety, planting/transplanting and orchard age confirmation

findings.finding: Hosted language PoC endpoints are not a guaranteed free production service
findings.resolution: BHASHINI approved commercial terms or evaluate pinned self-hosted AI4Bharat models. Confirm crop names, units, dates and numbers across target languages; keep original text

findings.finding: Crop doctor needs a useful referral when evidence or confidence is low
findings.resolution: Curate dated ICAR KVK directory entries and official NPSS links; no assumed public diagnosis API, fake contacts or appointment booking

findings.finding: Model project costs are not today’s local prices or a loan offer
findings.resolution: Use reviewed NABARD cost structure, farmer/local quote inputs, transport/commission/quality differences, sensitivity and actual sale/expense records

findings.finding: Centroids/GeoJSON do not provide validated land geometry or precise neighbor/weather overlap
findings.resolution: Validate geometries and coordinate order; add PostGIS/GiST when distance/containment endpoints are built; do not equate public town anchors to real farms

findings.finding: Private listing storage is not an implemented marketplace
findings.resolution: Sanitized opt-in listing endpoint, bounded availability/reservations, agreed terms, coarse geography and participant-only contacts; no fabricated accepted trades

findings.finding: Text search is a cheap baseline, not full multilingual semantic memory
findings.resolution: Optional pgvector in the same DB after crop/language retrieval evaluations; pin embedding model/version/dimension and apply owner/consent filters before retrieval

findings.finding: A consent table does not itself enforce revocation or deletion of objects
findings.resolution: Enforce purpose at gateway; revoke ingestion/sharing, process explicit deletion of records/derived memory/files, expire signed URLs, retain minimum evidence by policy

findings.finding: Adding every agriculture domain would undermine a stable first release
findings.resolution: Livestock/veterinary, fisheries, lending/payments, land-title validation and autonomous machinery are future modules, not represented as working features in this baseline

critical_next_steps: Import and review actual source data under verified access/usage terms
Bind v3 repositories, authenticated ownership and scoped write services to app endpoints
Calibrate actual hardware; keep actuator dispatch unavailable until tested
Rehearse full application/object-storage restore, reconcile legacy data and reversible cutover

free_stack.core: PostgreSQL + existing Python backend/worker + object storage
free_stack.optional: pgvector/PostGIS/self-hosted language models after measured need
free_stack.limits: Software/model code availability does not imply free hosted APIs, cloud compute, unlimited messaging or validated farming accuracy

validation_scope: Foundation constraints/restore rehearsal plus implemented API, assistant persistence, source adapters, document bytes, isolation and UI acceptance. Model accuracy and physical actuation are not claimed.
baseline_status: Reviewed current-feature data build baseline v3.1.0; change future schema through versioned migrations

implemented: Canonical authenticated API and classic compatibility
Farmer RLS and scoped write/ingestion roles
Durable assistant events, questions, approvals, archives and compaction
Task row versions and artifact previews/downloads
Crop-photo validation, persisted uncertainty, configured vision and voice
Deployed Open-Meteo/ERA5/NASA POWER ingestion with leases and source health
Consented live onboarding, farm/plot/cycle/soil ingress and hashed device enrollment
external_conditions: Configured OGD source timed out; actual mandi import remains unverified
Physical hardware absent; no actuator/external delivery dispatcher enabled
Research source catalog includes undeployed optional categories
Multilingual agronomic/vision model evaluation and production restore drill remain separate launch criteria
runtime_update.evidence: OPERATIONS.md and outputs/skyview-v3-integration; findings above preserve the foundation review at the time it was written
